title: Police Subdue Top-Tier Thugs, Seize Firearms and Bladed Weapons in Shahr-e-Rey
text:
Police Subdue Top-Tier Thugs, Seize Firearms and Bladed Weapons in Shahr-e-Rey"

""

"The Police Chief of Rey County announced that security forces have arrested a group of high-level hooligans in the 13 Aban district of Shahr-e-Rey, a historical city located in southern Tehran."

"According to the official statement, the individuals had been using bladed weapons to instigate street brawls and engage in blatant displays of force in public thoroughfares. Their actions had caused widespread fear and significantly disrupted public peace and safety for local residents."

"Law enforcement officers responded promptly and carried out a decisive tactical operation, successfully subduing and apprehending the primary suspect. During the operation, as well as through follow-up intelligence and investigative measures, police confiscated a number of both bladed weapons and firearms from the suspects."

"In continued police efforts over the past several days, additional individuals linked to these criminal activities have been identified and subsequently arrested."
